name: yt-localizer
description: Chrome MV3 extension + CLI to translate YouTube titles/descriptions and publish official localizations via YouTube Data API v3
author: Mykola Rudnev

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:extension: VT_TARGET=background vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && VT_TARGET=content vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && VT_TARGET=options vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && VT_TARGET=popup vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts
